title: Ziyarat of Fatima bint Asad
intro: The ziyarat of Fatima bint Asad, mother of Imam Ali, extracted as a distinct complete recitation from the Madinah collection.
description: Read Ziyarat of Fatima bint Asad with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُُ عَلَى نَبِيِّ اللهِ السَّلاَمُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ
blocks.transliteration: assalaamo a'laa nabiyyil laahe assalaamo a'laa rasoolil laahe
blocks.english: Peace be on the Prophet of Allah, Peace be on the Messenger of Allah,

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ سَيِّدِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ
blocks.transliteration: assalaamo a'laa mohammadin sayyedil mursaleena
blocks.english: Peace be on Muhammad the leader of the Messengers,

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ سَيِّدِ الْأَوَّلِينَ
blocks.transliteration: assalaamo a'la mohammadin sayyedil awwaleena
blocks.english: Peace be on Muhammad the leader of the foremost ones.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ سَيِّدِ الْآخِرِينَ
blocks.transliteration: assalaamo a'laa mohammadin sayyedil aakhereena
blocks.english: Peace be on Muhammad the leader of the last ones.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُُ عَلَى مَنْ بَعَثَهُ اللهُ رَحْمَةً لِلْعَالَمِينَ
blocks.transliteration: assalaamo a'laa man ba-a'sahul laaho rahmatan lil-a'alameena
blocks.english: Peace be on one whom Allah sent as a mercy to the universe.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَ رَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ
blocks.transliteration: assalaamo a'layka ayyohan nabiyyo wa rahmatul laahe wa barakaatohu
blocks.english: Peace be on you, O Prophet and the mercy and blessings of Allah be upon you.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُُ عَلَى فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ أَسَدٍ الْهَاشِمِيَّةِ
blocks.transliteration: assalaamo a'laa faatemata binte asadenil haashemiyyate
blocks.english: Peace be on Fatima, the daughter of Asad, the Hashimite,

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ أَيَّتُهَا الصِّدِّيقَةُ الْمَرْضِيَّةُ
blocks.transliteration: assalaamo a'layke ayyatohs siddeeqatul marziyyato
blocks.english: Peace be upon you O truthful and contented one;

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ أَيَّتُهَا التَّقِيَّةُ النَّقِيَّةُ
blocks.transliteration: assalaamo a'layke ayyatohat taqiyyatun naqiyyato
blocks.english: Peace be upon you O virtuous and pure one;

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُُ عَلَيْكِ أَيَّتُهَا الْكَرِيمَةُ الرَّضِيَّةُ (الْمَرْضِيَّةُ) ا
blocks.transliteration: assalaamo a'layke ayyatohal kareematur raziyyato
blocks.english: Peace be upon You O noble and contented one;

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَم عَلَيْكِ يَا كَافِلَةَ مُحَمَّدٍ خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّينَ
blocks.transliteration: assalaamo a'layke yaa kaafelata mohammadin khaatamin nabiyyeena
blocks.english: Peace be upon you O one who looked after Muhammad, the seal of the Prophets.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُُ عَلَيْكِ يَا وَالِدَةَ سَيِّدِ الْوَصِيِّينَ
blocks.transliteration: assalaamo a'layka yaa waaledata sayyedil wasiyyeena
blocks.english: Peace be upon you O mother of the leader of the successors.

blocks.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكِ يَا مَنْ ظَهَرَتْ شَفَقَتُهَا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّينَ
blocks.transliteration: assalaamo a'layka yaa man zaharat sha-fa-qatohaa a'laa rasoolil laahe khatamin nabiyyeena
blocks.english: Peace be upon you who showed compassion to the Prophet of Allah, seal of the Prophets;

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُُ عَلَيْكِ يَا مَنْ تَرْبِيَتُهَا لِوَلِيِّ اللهِ الْأَمِينِ
blocks.transliteration: assalaamo a'layka yaa man tarbeyatohaa le-waliyyil laahilameene
blocks.english: Peace be upon you O one who raised the trustworthy friend of Allah;

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُُ عَلَيْكِ وَ عَلَى رُوحِكِ وَ بَدَنِكِ الطَّاهِرِ
blocks.transliteration: assalaamo a'layke wa a'laa rooheke wa badanekit tahere
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, on your soul and on your pure body;

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُُ عَلَيْكِ وَ عَلَى وَلَدِكِ وَ رَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ
blocks.transliteration: assalaamu aliki waalaa waladiki warahmatullahi wabarakatuhu.
blocks.english: May peace, mercy and blessings be upon you and on your son.

blocks.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكِ أَحْسَنْتِ الْكَفَالَةَ وَ أَدَّيْتِ الْأَمَانَةَ
blocks.transliteration: ashhadu annaki ahsantil kifaalata waaddaitil amanata
blocks.english: I bear witness that you supported in the best manner possible and fulfilled your obligation

blocks.arabic: وَ اجْتَهَدْتِ فِي مَرْضَاةِ اللهِ
blocks.transliteration: wajtahadti fii marzaatillahi
blocks.english: and strived for the pleasure of Allah

blocks.arabic: وَ بَالَغْتِ فِي حِفْظِ رَسُولِ اللهِ
blocks.transliteration: wabalghti fii hifzi rasulillahi
blocks.english: and exerted yourself in protecting the Prophet of Allah,

blocks.arabic: عَارِفَةً بِحَقِّهِ مُؤْمِنَةً بِصِدْقِهِ مُعْتَرِفَةً بِنُبُوَّتِهِ
blocks.transliteration: aarifatan bihaqqihi muminatan bisidqihi mutarifatan bi nubuwwatihi
blocks.english: being aware of his status; believing in his truthfulness; acknowledging his prophecy,

blocks.arabic: مُسْتَبْصِرَةً بِنِعْمَتِهِ كَافِلَةً بِتَرْبِيَتِهِ
blocks.transliteration: mustabsiratan biniamatihi kaafilatn bitarbiyatihi
blocks.english: perceiving his blessings; taking responsibility of his upbringing,

blocks.arabic: مُشْفِقَةً عَلَى نَفْسِهِ وَاقِفَةً عَلَى خِدْمَتِهِ
blocks.transliteration: mushfiqatan alaa nafsihi waaqifatan alaa khidmatihi
blocks.english: dealing with him affectionately; ready to serve him;

blocks.arabic: (مُخْتَارَةً رِضَاهُ (مُؤْثِرَةً هَوَاهُ
blocks.transliteration: mukhtaaratan rizaahu wamusiratan hawaahu
blocks.english: choosing what please him, preferring what he like;

blocks.arabic: وَ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكِ مَضَيْتِ عَلَى الْإِيمَانِ
blocks.transliteration: waashhadu annaki mazaiti allal limani
blocks.english: I bear witness that you spent your life on the (true) faith

blocks.arabic: وَ التَّمَسُّكِ بِأَشْرَفِ الْأَدْيَانِ رَاضِيَةً مَرْضِيَّةً
blocks.transliteration: wattamssuki biashrafil advaani raziyatan marziyyatan
blocks.english: and adhering to the most noble religion, being pleased and contented,

blocks.arabic: طَاهِرَةً زَكِيَّةً تَقِيَّةً نَقِيَّةً فَرَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْكِ
blocks.transliteration: taahiratn zakiyyatan taqiyyatan naqiyyatan faraziyallahu anki
blocks.english: pure, clean, guarded and virtuous.May Allah be pleased and satisfied with you;

blocks.arabic: وَ أَرْضَاكِ وَ جَعَلَ الْجَنَّةَ مَنْزِلَكِ وَ مَأْوَاكِ
blocks.transliteration: waarzaaki wajaalal jannata manzilaki wamaawaki. …
blocks.english: may He make heaven as your house and permanent abode.

blocks.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma salli alaa muhammadin walli muhammadin
blocks.english: O Allah, send your greetings on Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

blocks.arabic: وَ انْفَعْنِي بِزِيَارَتِهَا وَ ثَبِّتْنِي عَلَى مَحَبَّتِهَا
blocks.transliteration: waanfanii biziyaratiha wasabbiitnii alaa mahabbatiha
blocks.english: and make my visiting her beneficial to me and make me firm in my love for her

blocks.arabic: وَ لاَ تَحْرِمْنِي شَفَاعَتَهَا وَ شَفَاعَةَ الْأَئِمَّةِ مِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِهَا
blocks.transliteration: walaa tahrimnii shafaataha washafaatal aimmati min dhuriyyatiha
blocks.english: and do not deprive me of her intercession and the intercession of the Imams from her loins;

blocks.arabic: وَ ارْزُقْنِي مُرَافَقَتَهَا وَ احْشُرْنِي مَعَهَا وَ مَعَ أَوْلاَدِهَا الطَّاهِرِينَ
blocks.transliteration: warzuqnii muraafaqataha wahashurnii maaba wama-a-awladiha-ttahiriina.
blocks.english: so grant me her company and gather me with her and with her pure children;

blocks.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَجْعَلْهُ آخِرَ الْعَهْدِ مِنْ زِيَارَتِي إِيَّاهَا
blocks.transliteration: allahumma laa tajalhu aakhiral ahdi min ziyaratii iyyahaa
blocks.english: O Allah, do not make it my last visit to her

blocks.arabic: وَ ارْزُقْنِي الْعَوْدَ إِلَيْهَا أَبَداً مَا أَبْقَيْتَنِي
blocks.transliteration: warzuqniil awda ilaiha abadan maa abqaitnii
blocks.english: and grant me another visit to her as long as You keep me alive

blocks.arabic: وَ إِذَا تَوَفَّيْتَنِي فَاحْشُرْنِي فِي زُمْرَتِهَا
blocks.transliteration: waidhaa tawaffaitanii fiii zumratina
blocks.english: and if You cause me to die then gather me with her ranks

blocks.arabic: وَ أَدْخِلْنِي فِي شَفَاعَتِهَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
blocks.transliteration: waadkhilnii fii shafaatin birahmatika yaa arhamaarahimiin.
blocks.english: and include me amongst those receiving her intercession by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the Merciful ones.

blocks.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِحَقِّهَا عِنْدَكَ وَ مَنْزِلَتِهَا لَدَيْكَ اغْفِرْ لِي
blocks.transliteration: allahumma bihaqqiha indakaa wamanzilatiha ladaika ighfirlii
blocks.english: O Allah, I ask You by her status and high position in front of You, forgive me

blocks.arabic: وَ لِوَالِدَيَّ وَ لِجَمِيعِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
blocks.transliteration: waliwaalidayya walijamiil muminiina walmuminati
blocks.english: and my parents and all believing men and women

blocks.arabic: وَ آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَ فِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَ قِنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ عَذَابَ النَّارِ
blocks.transliteration: waatina fidduniya hasanatan wafil aakhirati hasanatan waqina birahmatik adhabannar
blocks.english: and grant us goodness in this and the next world and save us, by Your mercy, from the punishment of the fire.

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ زیارت حضرت فاطمہ بنت اسد کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
